reviews.comment:
Excelente atencion. Los playeros muy amables. Al ser la unica estacion de santa clara seguramente habrá espera, ir con paciencia. Lo unico a criticar es la manguera para calibrar las ruedas del auto, es muy corta! Pero es un detalle muy menor. Tiene un pequeño quiosco.

(Translated by Google)
Excellent service. The attendants were very friendly. Since it's the only gas station in Santa Clara, there will likely be a wait, so be patient. The only downside is the tire pressure gauge hose; it's very short! But it's a minor detail. They also have a small kiosk.
